assertion.statement: Cilium cluster name is now validated (max 32 lowercase alphanumerics or '-', starting and ending alphanumeric); bypassable via upgradeCompatibility v1.15 or earlier until strict enforcement in v1.17.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The text does not name the setting key that carries the cluster name, so no predicate can be written for it.; consequence: The text says the name is validated but not what happens to an invalid name (rejection or failure).
